description: This file defines cultural localization information for Chinese (China) for a date handling library (DateJS), including date formats, day/month names, regex patterns, and prototype extensions for Date objects.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) of a date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a new Date object representing the start of the current day.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two dates, returning -1, 0, or 1 depending on their order.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day based on its name in the culture's day names.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on its name in the culture's month names.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines whether a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a specific year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation based on offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for a given timezone name.
